notes.title: Genomon Demo Update Feb 15 2021
notes.content:
Changelist

Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where the wrong Genomon would be sold in the shop
- Fixed issue where Genomon list buttons in the shop would be sized awkwardly in some resolutions or windowed modes
- Fixed issue where Genomon would be listed in the Teleport Genomon menu even if they were sold

notes.title: Genomon Demo Update Feb 5 2021
notes.content:
Changelist
[list]
[*] Tuned Loot System to be less grindy
[*] Tuned Battle Expedition AI stats
[*] Fixed an issue where in some cases players would get much more loot then intended
[*] Reduced falloff radius of animal Jump sound
[*] Reduced Volume of demolish sound
[*] Adjusted grass painting on hill near the Helicopter
[*] Added additional possible aggressive trait loot to sector 04 and sector 05
[/list]
